title: Scapular manipulation
view: Patient prone across the frame, seen from the right side and above: head on the image right, hips on the left, the right arm hanging off the near edge of the stretcher.
teachingPoint: Prone, the arm hanging with gentle traction; rotate the inferior tip of the scapula toward the spine with low, steady force.
claims: Prone, the affected (right) arm hanging off the stretcher with gentle traction (record, positioning).
Right scapula outlined on the back: medial border, inferior tip, spine and acromion (standard anatomy, traced on the painting).
Curved arrow: the inferior tip rotated medially toward the spine (record: rotate the scapular tip; the medial direction is standard technique, added).
Straight arrow down the arm: gentle traction (record).
Labels: Rotate the tip toward the spine; Spine; Scapula; Arm hangs, gentle traction.
